verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a remote-desktop product with address books, settings and audit logs, but the evidence documents no export feature or open export format. Self-hosting, the AGPL licence and a community remark about 'no vendor lock-in' describe data residency and openness, not an export-and-leave capability, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
